_comment: The exact REMORA core artifacts this product build consumes. AAE never installs from REMORA master and never imports internal REMORA modules; it pins this set and verifies every hash before use.
release_status_reason: Adds deployment-declared tool classification, the deterministic GROUNDED_READ_ACCEPT path, and per-surface production prerequisites — the three things that were keeping this product to three of its four decisions. Every frozen contract artifact is byte-identical to the previous candidate; only the wheel moved. Still a prerelease: no external review has run against this build, Gate B is not closed, and there is no signed image, SBOM or build provenance. Pinnable, not blessed.
